## Community-level niche breadth analysis

# Load packages

```{r}
library(spaa)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Import taxonomic community data

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Niche_breadth/Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
head(design)
comm01 <- read.csv("./Niche_breadth/Data/RPKM.species.abundance.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
comm <- t(comm01[ ,rownames(design)])
comm <- comm[,colSums(comm) > 20]
```


# Calculate niche breadth and perform two-group statistical analysis

```{r}
# Calculate niche breadth for each OTU by group
b_values_by_group <- lapply(names(table(design$Irrigation)), function(g) {
  # Filter the samples in the current group
  samples <- rownames(design)[design$Irrigation == g]
  comm_subset <- comm[samples, , drop = FALSE]
  # Filter the OTUs present in the current group
  otus_present <- colSums(comm_subset) > 0
  comm_subset <- comm_subset[, otus_present, drop = FALSE]
  # calculate B-values
  b_vals <- niche.width(comm_subset, method = "levins")
  # Create a data frame containing group names, OTU names, and B values
  data.frame(Group = g, OTU = names(b_vals), B_value = as.numeric(b_vals))
})

# Merge niche breadth value and group value
b_values_df <- do.call(rbind, b_values_by_group)
head(b_values_df)
dim(comm)

# Calculate by Group Bcom
bcom_by_group <- tapply(b_values_df$B_value, b_values_df$Group, mean)
bcom_by_group


# Statistical test
head(b_values_df)
wilcox.test(B_value ~ Group, data = b_values_df)
```


# Plot niche breadth

```{r}
theme.plot <- theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 15),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(colour= "black", size= 15, angle= 35, hjust = 1),
                    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 15),
                    legend.position = "NULL",
                    panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
                    panel.grid = element_blank(),
                    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
                    
p1 <- ggplot(b_values_df, aes(x = Group, y = B_value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_boxplot(width= 0.17, fill= "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4169B2", "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Niche breadths (Bcom)", title = "Taxonomy") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme.plot + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 48), breaks = seq(0, 48, 10))

p1
ggsave("./Niche_breadth/Output/Taxonomic_Niche_Breadth.pdf", p1, width = 3.5, height = 5)
```



# Import functional community data


# Calculate niche breadth and perform two-group statistical analysis

```{r}
# Calculate niche breadth for each OTU by group
b_values_by_group <- lapply(names(table(design$Irrigation)), function(g) {
  # Filter the samples in the current group
  samples <- rownames(design)[design$Irrigation == g]
  comm_subset <- comm[samples, , drop = FALSE]
  # Filter the OTUs present in the current group
  otus_present <- colSums(comm_subset) > 0
  comm_subset <- comm_subset[, otus_present, drop = FALSE]
  # calculate B-values
  b_vals <- niche.width(comm_subset, method = "levins")
  # Create a data frame containing group names, OTU names, and B values
  data.frame(Group = g, OTU = names(b_vals), B_value = as.numeric(b_vals))
})

# Merge niche breadth value and group value
b_values_df <- do.call(rbind, b_values_by_group)
head(b_values_df)
dim(comm)

# Calculate by Group Bcom
bcom_by_group <- tapply(b_values_df$B_value, b_values_df$Group, mean)
bcom_by_group


# Statistical test
head(b_values_df)
```
